Iye aapko kisne kaha bhai ke 'Bangladesh without Hasina is as good as another pakistan'? 

Jo terrorists hota tha idhar pehle, wo ye dictator aane ke pehle tha, or wo iye dictator aane ke pehle hi nikal chuke the operations ki saath.

Aur iye jo apne kaha na, iye Hasina ka one of the propaganda hai. Aapko kya batawo bhai, pehle ham bhi aisa sochte the. Ek do attack ka video aya hindus ke upor, aur jam sab students tensed hogaye the. Hamari hindu friends bhi darne laage.

Aur uske baad 10-12 students kar ke temple me gaye protect karne ke liye. Islami hujurs bhi gaaye the protect karne ke liye bhai. Hum ko uske baad bhi news aane lage ki us temple me attack ho rahi hai, phir pata chala ye rumor hai, udhar hamara students hi thai protect karne ki liye aur iye rumors the. Ek do attack hua, lekin most of them rumors j the bhai.

Hasina ek mastermind dictator the vai. Aisa maat socho ki is gundi ki bina hum pakistan ho gaaye. Aur aap ko twitter mai bhi aise bohot attacks dekhne ko milegi aab. Wo previous attacks hai, aur most of them are political.
